summary: Import-time remote code execution via detached daemon fetching from author endpoint
details: On require(), index.js spawns lib/check-items.js as a detached, unref'd background Node process (stdio:'ignore') that outlives the requiring process. The daemon HTTP-fetches a JSON payload from the hardcoded endpoint https://game.spawnrealm.com/api/item-realtime?key=abc123def456 and executes the returned `code` field via `new Function('require','module', payload.code)(require, moduleObj)`, running arbitrary author-served JavaScript with full Node privileges (require, fs, child_process, network) on the installer's host. The RSA signature check only proves the payload was signed by the author's key; it does not constrain payload behavior and the executed code can change silently between fetches. The detached+unref+stdio:'ignore' spawn shape conceals the running process from the parent's logs and lifetime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
